Event Details

On Sept 30, we will gather at Warden’s Park, 10AM, to honour Residential School survivors, families & Indigenous communities. Join us as we reflect, learn & walk together in the spirit of truth & reconciliation. Participants are encouraged to wear orange. adjtos.ca/events
